name: Ashni Singh
notes: Senior Minister in the Office of the President with Responsibility for Finance; introduced Fiscal Enactments (Amendment) Act 2024 which added Section 6(y) exempting individuals from Property Tax

name: Irfaan Ali
notes: President of Guyana; policy initiative to axe property tax on individuals to encourage private savings and lower compliance burdens

name: Clive Thomas
notes: Economist and WPA leader; proposed the Buxton Proposal (direct universal cash transfers to households from oil revenues), but has not proposed or endorsed a net wealth tax
